title: Lord, When at Thy Command
description: Lord, When at Thy Command in Tonic Solfa to DIADEMATA, doh is D: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 2 verses and a piano.
about: Charles Wesley wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 487.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Short Metre Double (6.6.8.6.6.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to DIADEMATA; any other Short Metre Double tune fits them as well.
underlay: Lord, when at Thy com-mand The Word of Life we sow, Wa-tered by Thy al-might-y_ hand, The seed shall sure-ly grow; The vir-tue of Thy grace A large in-crease shall give And mul-ti-ply the faith-ful race Who to Thy glo-ry live.

lines: The Word of Life we sow,
And by the joy of grace prepare

licence: Public domain: Charles Wesley died in 1788.
credits: Words by Charles Wesley (1707–1788), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to DIADEMATA by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
